TOP: Microsoft agent-framework PyPI package steals credentials
Exploited Puppet RCE added to CISA KEV

P.h: Official Microsoft agent-framework PyPI package ships a credential stealer
P.p: TLDR InfoSec reports versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 of Microsoft's agent-framework were pushed from the official publisher account. A .pth file launches the stealer on every Python startup, even if nothing imports the package.
P.s: It harvests environment variables and credential files, then requests GitHub Actions OIDC, Azure DevOps OIDC and Azure managed identity tokens. The attacker is believed to still hold publishing access. Treat any install as a full compromise and rotate every reachable secret.

items.h: Two unauthenticated NGINX HTTP/2 RCEs found by Wiz
items.d: One is a use-after-free, the other an integer overflow. Either gives remote code execution. Upgrade to patched versions or disable HTTP/2.

items.h: CISA adds exploited Puppet RCE, CVSS 9.4, to KEV
items.d: A crafted PUT with rich-data runs code as the Puppet Server user. Weak auto-signing can expose unauthenticated attackers. Perforce patched on November 3.

items.h: Gitea public-only token scope bypass grants full admin
items.d: Escape Research: the scope was missing from the admin API. A token with write:admin could create a site admin and mint runner registration tokens.

items.h: A backdoored LLM fires only inside one agent harness
items.d: A QLoRA adapter trained for about one euro of power made Qwen3-8B emit a silent bash call. Sandbox agents and approve shell and network tool calls.

tiles.t: Chainguard goes self-serve with a free Starter tier
tiles.d: 5 near-zero-CVE images, 50,000 monthly pulls of malware-screened packages with a 7-day cooldown. Team plan is $500 per month.

tiles.t: AWS Security Hub now covers Google Cloud
tiles.d: GCP VMs, Artifact Registry, Cloud Run and identities, with CIS checks.

tiles.t: OWASP Top 10 for neoclouds and AI data centers
tiles.d: Incubator framework with ten risks for GPU clouds.

tiles.t: Smart card auth is not proof of presence
tiles.d: Phrack: any process can load the card minidriver and sign remotely. By design, so watch for unexpected minidriver loads.

tiles.t: CISA picks about 100 firms for hardening talks
tiles.d: Chosen using years of pre-positioning intelligence.
1 million token context, $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.
DynamoDB-compatible API on PostgreSQL, SQLite, Cassandra or MongoDB. Apache 2.0.

tiles.t: Publish forks, not AI pull requests
tiles.d: Maintainers drowning in AI PRs could browse forks instead and pull in what they like.

tiles.t: Daylight and SpikeStrip join the agent-defense wave
tiles.d: Daylight guards against prompt injection and risky MCPs. SpikeStrip adds reversible prompt decoys to HTML and JavaScript.
VPN device-trust recon plus Sigma and KQL detections.

items.d: About 980 million shares at $83, a market cap near $1.5 trillion. Trading is expected on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. OpenAI is likely to follow in 2027.
